title: How I run a kitchen tissue culture hood for orchids
body: Explant to flask walkthrough using MS medium, BAP, and PPM. Contamination rate dropped after switching brands. Shop now for the same jars I use.

title: A novel temporary immersion bioreactor protocol significantly improved somatic embryogenesis in banana
body: We report a first report of reduced contamination and higher survival using an optimized TIB protocol. Multiplication rate increased three-fold versus semi-solid MS medium. DOI: 10.0000/demo
author: Agromillora Research

title: Is the TC plant market saturated or is it just Etsy?
body: The market is flooded. Too many hobbyist sellers, another TC shop every week, race to the bottom on banana plantlets. Oversupply of mericlones and nothing new in the protocols. Barrier to entry is low.
author: u/meristematic

title: NuPlant launches robotic micropropagation system for commercial nurseries
body: The Australian biotech opened a lab and announced a partnership with Oglesby Plants. Automation of meristem culture is the breakthrough they are selling into a crowded market of TC labs.
